message: The other day, I found myself rummaging through old board games while waiting for dinner to finish cooking. It got me thinking about how we often forget the simple joys in life—like family game night—while we’re all glued to our screens. As I set up the Monopoly board, I also made a mental note to check the smoke alarms. You know, just in case my homemade pizza turns into a little too much excitement! 😂 Sometimes, rediscovering low-tech fun can remind us to keep our homes safe and cozy. What’s your favorite way to unplug and connect with loved ones?
